description: Flipt gRPC + HTTP + Process metrics. Covers grpc_server_* (go-grpc-prometheus), rpc_server_call_duration_seconds (OTel otelgrpc), http_server_* (OTel otelhttp), and process_* metrics.

targets.expr: sum by (grpc_method, grpc_service) (rate(grpc_server_handled_total{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", grpc_code="OK", grpc_method!="Check"}[$__rate_interval]))

panels.description: Non-OK gRPC response codes. Unauthenticated is expected for pre-auth requests.
panels.title: gRPC Error Rate by Method

panels.description: started_total minus handled_total = currently in-flight RPCs. Streaming RPCs (EvaluationSnapshotNamespaceStream) will show high numbers — that is expected.

targets.expr: sum by (grpc_method) (grpc_server_started_total{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", grpc_method!="Check"}) - sum by (grpc_method) (grpc_server_handled_total{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", grpc_method!="Check"})

panels.title: gRPC Active / In-Flight RPCs

panels.description: For unary RPCs recv≈sent≈RPS. For server_stream (EvaluationSnapshotNamespaceStream) sent >> recv — each stream pushes many messages.
panels.title: gRPC Messages Received / Sent per sec
gRPC Server (rpc_server_call_duration_seconds — OTel otelgrpc) ⚠ _sum is in nanoseconds

panels.description: Latency percentiles for unary RPCs only. Streaming methods excluded — their durations exceed the le="10" bucket ceiling and always return 10s.

targets.expr: histogram_quantile(0.50, sum by (le, rpc_method) (rate(rpc_server_call_duration_seconds_bucket{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", rpc_method!~".*[Hh]ealth.*", rpc_method!~".*Stream.*"}[$__rate_interval])))

histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le, rpc_method) (rate(rpc_server_call_duration_seconds_bucket{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", rpc_method!~".*[Hh]ealth.*", rpc_method!~".*Stream.*"}[$__rate_interval])))

histogram_quantile(0.99, sum by (le, rpc_method) (rate(rpc_server_call_duration_seconds_bucket{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", rpc_method!~".*[Hh]ealth.*", rpc_method!~".*Stream.*"}[$__rate_interval])))

panels.title: OTel gRPC Latency — Unary (p50/p95/p99)

panels.description: Stream connection duration percentiles. Note: buckets only go to le="10s", so long-lived streams (>10s) land in +Inf and quantiles return 10s — use grpc_server_handling_seconds panels for reliable stream latency instead.

targets.expr: histogram_quantile(0.50, sum by (le, rpc_method) (rate(rpc_server_call_duration_seconds_bucket{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", rpc_method!~".*[Hh]ealth.*", rpc_method=~".*Stream.*"}[$__rate_interval])))

histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le, rpc_method) (rate(rpc_server_call_duration_seconds_bucket{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", rpc_method!~".*[Hh]ealth.*", rpc_method=~".*Stream.*"}[$__rate_interval])))

histogram_quantile(0.99, sum by (le, rpc_method) (rate(rpc_server_call_duration_seconds_bucket{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", rpc_method!~".*[Hh]ealth.*", rpc_method=~".*Stream.*"}[$__rate_interval])))

panels.title: OTel gRPC Latency — Streams (p50/p95/p99) ⚠ capped at 10s
